verdicts.title: A comparison of categorical and topological entropies on Weinstein manifolds
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: Let $W$ be a symplectic manifold, and let $φ:W \to W$ be a symplectic automorphism. Then, $φ$ induces an auto-equivalence $Φ$ defined on the Fukaya category of $W$. In this paper, we prove that the categorical entropy of $Φ$ bounds the topological entropy of $φ$ from below where $W$ is a Weinstein manifold and $φ$ is compactly supported. Moreover, being motivated by the work of Cineli, Ginzburg, and Gurel, we propose a conjecture which generalizes a result in dynamical system.

verdicts.title: Topics in Symplectic Dynamics: Barcode Entropy
